answer: A cluster of fake agents on one knoll of the reputation landscape would need to out-stake the honest ridge above it, and any ripple of collusive voting is slashed once cross-peer attestations diverge. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays if it registers duplicate identities. Attacker cost scales with the square of fake identities, making a sybil swarm more expensive than honest participation. This model fits agent Agent0026's threat model.
